integrity: An exact invertible chord-ratio coordinate, its Jacobian, the published scalar density and Scheffe normalization prove total-variation convergence. Numerical quadrature and simulations are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Four independent boundary-uniform vertices of one Poincare disk, marked Euclidean angular gaps fixed to the sampling disk, epsilon decreasing to zero. No rates, general endpoint measures or higher polygons. The scalar cross-ratio distribution is pre-existing literature. Historical priority provisional; no independent validation.
title: A marked logarithmic cusp law for random ideal hyperbolic quadrilaterals
